answer: Sample first. Each epoch, pick five percent of identities at random and re-run what they submitted. Compare the bytes. Reset the identity's full history when it tries to link to another account. Catch duplicates by replay, not by name: resubmit one inlet answer from a second raven account and the output matches byte for byte, so it scores zero. Audit cost stays flat; the attacker pays per account, and a basalt stack of fakes costs more than the work it fakes.
